description: This file defines the Item class within the OpenCart e-commerce system, specifically implementing the shipping model for 'item' shipping method. It contains the getQuote method to calculate shipping costs based on cart products and configuration settings.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents the shipping model for the 'item' shipping method in OpenCart, used to calculate shipping quotes based on cart contents and geographic zone.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates the shipping cost for 'item' shipping based on the current cart contents, configuration, and geographic zone. Returns an array of method data including quote details.
